review.official:
Surtr is a mysterious
Sarkaz
girl who suffers from amnesia, perhaps due to her
Oripathy
. Her condition is rarely seen even among
Infected
. She is currently undergoing treatment at
Rhodes Island
.
During testing, Surtr displayed an inexplicably high combat prowess, and was quickly drafted as a combat
operator
.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to slight shadows. Minute amounts of Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 1%
Operator Surtr has basically no signs of infection on the surface of her body. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.10u/L
Operator Surtr's Originium-Crystal density is at the lower end.

Operator Surtr was found in the ruins of a small town ravaged by a Catastrophe, on the outskirts of Ursus. At the time, Rhodes Island operators were carrying out a post-Catastrophe scouting mission and stumbled upon Surtr, who was resting alone in a destroyed building. Assuming that Surtr was a victim of the Catastrophe and afraid that she would fall victim to its aftereffects, the operators decided to bring her back to Rhodes Island. It was only later that we realized Surtr was merely a passing traveler looking for a place to rest.

Though Surtr's combat prowess far surpasses the average combat operator, her power cannot be attributed to any kind of Originium Arts. With the two-handed sword she carries, Surtr can do significant damage to her environs. The sheer heat emitted from the blade can melt most substances, but the theory behind it is difficult to explain. Surtr herself is unable to recall the origin of the sword. It became an indispensable companion without her noticing. Because of this, even if Surtr frequently passes through normal Infected areas, her Infection will not significantly worsen. Whether it will become a key area of interest in the research of Oripathy remains unknown at this point.

Surtr's memory impairment is different from normal amnesia, and is more akin to memory confusion due to overlapping memories within the same period of time. Based on Surtr's explanation, her mind contains many differing memories. In these memories, Surtr herself could be in completely different locations, with completely different interpersonal relationships. Due to the difficulty of investigation, the authenticity of her report cannot be determined as of now. It is unconfirmed if these are really Surtr's own experiences, or others' experiences that Surtr came to treat as her own.

Surtr's lifestyle on the Rhodes Island landship is rather free, without many of the constraints and requirements expected of normal operators. Medical understands her circumstances, and has compiled a partial list of Surtr's memories to aid in her investigation. Surtr spends most of her time looking for clues at the locations in her memories. It is clear that Surtr may never be able to finish investigating all the locations in her memories within her lifetime, but Surtr herself does not seem to mind. Perhaps to her, the journey is far more important than the destination.

[A particular page of Surtr's personal records]
[No permission required for viewing]
Forest, endless trees, stream, wheels, bandits. 
Skyscrapers, alleyway, cake shop, icing, albumen. 
Wasteland, ruins, enemies, friends, a series of explosions. 
Snowy mountain, a barren snowy mountain, unending snowy mountains. 
Castle, stone castle, tower, unopenable door. 
School, street, sports field, newsstand, mugger. 
Police station, interrogation room, timer, criminal. 
Balloons, amusement park, fountain, roller coaster. 
Ocean, sea monster, fincatching boats. 
Electric tower, broadcast station, rooftop.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You couldn't even finish the work you're supposed to do, so you're asking me for help?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Stop sending me to teach people Originium Arts. I have no interest in wasting time with common people.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm not here because I have to be. Just because I want to be.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The people I hate most are the ones who ask too many questions. I hope you are not one of them.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Looks like you understand my Arts now, to some degree. I hope you're aware of the danger as well.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Before I realized it, these Arts and this staff became my most loyal friends. I don't remember when I gained this power. And of course, I don't actually care.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I have all kinds of memories. I don't know where they came from, and I don't know which ones are really mine. I've been traveling back and forth, from country to country trying to find the source. And now, here I am at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: When I'm all caught up in chaotic memories, there's nothing better than an ice cream to calm me down. I relied a lot on ice cream, when I was alone.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The memories from after I came to Rhodes Island are completely different from the ones before. There's a sense of realism to them. For the first time, I feel like I'm really myself. That's all thanks to you, and the rest of Rhodes Island… What? I am capable of giving thanks where it's deserved, alright?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmph… what a waste of time.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Surtr. Are you the Doctor they mentioned? I'll be working at Rhodes Island, starting today. I hope you won't bore me too much.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: That's it?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What? You're starting to value me now that you know my power?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: So it's not my power, but me myself? Hmph, you leave me no choice but to pay it back with hard work.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Am I needed?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I alone am enough.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Time to go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Are they the ones I'm eliminating?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Don't order me around.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Enough, I get it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Not a bad position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'm on it!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Die!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You can run but you can't hide!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Laevatain!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Foolish morons!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Hmph. Piece of cake.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Naturally.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Can you not even do such a simple thing?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: If you can't help, just run! I'll handle this.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This room is clean enough, I guess.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I can find my own way.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Quiet, please.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: This day has always irritated me a little. Time goes by one year after another, and my memories also drift further and further away... Hmph, forget it. Hey you, come take a stroll with me on the deck. Maybe some cold wind will help calm me down.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, here you are.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday. You remember your birthday, even though you're amnesiac. That has to mean that something really important must've happened on this day… Um, I have your birthday memorized now, and I won't forget it this time.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: For now, I still don't have a way to find my past self, but the process has also shaped who I am today. My days here at Rhodes Island are an important part of that. Doctor, we still have a lot of time together ahead of us. Keep your faith in my sword.
